welcome.title: A notepad for your job applications
welcome.intro: You fill in each job yourself, so you always know what you've applied for, with which CV, and when it's time to follow up. Nothing is fetched or sent automatically. There are no accounts, and everything is saved only in this browser.

step1.title: Add your CV (optional)
step1.body: Upload a PDF, so you always see which CV you sent to which job.

step2.title: Add a job you want to apply for
step2.body: Fill in the company, and paste the link to the ad if you like.

step3.title: Mark it when you've applied
step3.body: Then the app counts the days for you and shows when it is time to follow up.

welcome.tip: Tip: download a backup now and then, so you always have a copy of your data.
